problem.title: Quota Window
problem.statementMarkdown: Return the shortest contiguous substring of `text` containing every character of `quota` with at least its multiplicity. Match characters exactly, including case. Ties choose the earliest substring. Return an empty string if quota is empty or no window exists.

examples.explanation: BCA is the earliest shortest substring containing A, B, and C.
aab supplies two a characters and one b.
